description: This file defines the 'SiloHostedService' class, which implements the 'IHostedService' interface to manage the lifecycle (start and stop) of an Orleans Silo within a hosting environment. It includes methods for starting and stopping the silo, as well as internal logging and configuration validation.

classes.name: SiloHostedService
classes.description: A hosted service that manages the lifecycle of an Orleans Silo, including starting, stopping, and logging lifecycle events.

methods.name: SiloHostedService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SiloHostedService with dependencies and performs configuration validation.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the Orleans Silo and logs the start event.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the Orleans Silo and logs the stop event.

methods.name: ValidateSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the provided system configuration validators.

methods.name: LogInformationStartingSilo
methods.description: Logs that the Orleans Silo is starting.

methods.name: LogInformationSiloStarted
methods.description: Logs that the Orleans Silo has started.

methods.name: LogInformationStoppingSilo
methods.description: Logs that the Orleans Silo is stopping.

methods.name: LogInformationSiloStopped
methods.description: Logs that the Orleans Silo has stopped.
